chunks: We shall ask Hell that day: 'Are you full?' It will answer: 'Are there still more?'
ai.seo_question: What does Hell say when asked if it is full on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Qaf (50:30) illustrates the anthropomorphic capacity of Hell to expand, reflecting the infinite justice of Allah who accommodates the multitude of sinners without diminishment. The rhetorical question 'Is there more?' underscores the boundless nature of divine retribution, a concept often linked with the idea that Hell's punishment is tailored to the specific sins of its inhabitants, ensuring no soul is treated unjustly.
